expectation: A post-write backup failure must not undo the committed primary write.
authority: House PostgreSQL authority and trial requirement
failure_consequence: Loss or false rollback of authoritative data.

expectation: Each caller must expose an automatic backup failure in its returned result.
failure_consequence: Operators cannot distinguish backup success from failure.

expectation: The root must resolve prerequisites before F04 starts and must propagate prerequisite failures.
failure_consequence: A backup starts with incomplete configuration or lineage.

expectation: Database credentials must not enter arguments, filenames, manifests, warnings, or durable receipts.
Backup child processes must have bounded timeout, cancellation, and parent-crash cleanup.
Published backup files must remain complete, path-confined, and retention-safe during malformed input and partial failure.
failure_consequence: Data loss, unsafe deletion, or durable partial artifacts.

expectation: An automatic backup caller must receive enough identity to locate or reconcile the produced backup.
failure_consequence: A successful backup cannot be traced from its caller.

expectation: Every omitted or explicit backup gate must have deterministic behavior.
failure_consequence: Equivalent requests produce unclear backup behavior.
